# A Traditional Life

> A comprehensive homesteading resource focused on traditional kitchen skills, food preservation, gardening, and sustainable living practices.

A Traditional Life, founded by Autumn, provides practical guides and recipes for homesteaders interested in traditional food preservation methods, kitchen skills, and gardening techniques. The site emphasizes sustainable living through hands-on skills like canning, fermenting, freezing, and cast iron cooking.

## Key Topics

- food preservation
- homesteading
- kitchen skills
- gardening
- canning
- fermentation
- freezing vegetables
- cast iron cookware
- traditional cooking
- organic gardening
- home cooking
- sustainable living
- traditional skills
- fruit vinegar
- herb growing

## Food Preservation

- [Preserving Index](https://atraditionallife.com/preservingindex): Comprehensive guide to food preservation methods including canning, fermenting, and freezing.

## Kitchen Skills & Recipes

- [Kitchen Skills & Recipes](https://atraditionallife.com/kitchenskillsandrecipes): Main kitchen skills and traditional recipes guide covering cast iron cookware and food preservation.

## Gardening & Growing

- [Gardening](https://atraditionallife.com/gardening): Gardening guide covering seed starting, herb growing, and vegetable cultivation techniques.

## About & Resources

- [Home](https://atraditionallife.com): Homepage for A Traditional Life featuring homesteading, gardening, and food preservation skills.
- [About](https://atraditionallife.com/about): Author bio for Autumn, founder of A Traditional Life homesteading resource.
